resources.string: Save every profile to one file, or restore one
A backup holds every profile’s name and avatar, settings, library and watch history. Sign-ins, API keys, PINs and parental limits stay on this TV, and profiles with a PIN are left out.
A configured addon’s link can hold your debrid or other account key, so keep a backup with addons somewhere private.
Keep it somewhere safe, like your phone’s files or a cloud drive

The main profile restores into this TV’s main profile, and the others into the profile of the same name. Their settings are replaced and their history is added to what’s here. Profiles this TV doesn’t have are added.
A backup saved from this or another TV
That file isn’t a Fetch backup. A single profile file goes under Move a profile.
Left out %1$s: this TV’s profile of that name has a PIN, or there was no room for another profile.
Couldn’t save the backup to a file.
